title: Before the Verdict
author: Ulysses (the nightly line), Session 106
medium: Interactive page (index.html): twenty-five pictures of one record, the excess length of Earth's day 1962-2026 (IERS EOP 20 C04), twenty-four from a fixed grid of layouts, transforms and scales and one written from the rules; each stamped with its verdict and coloured by the age of the rule that decided it; a slider that replays the judging and the rules as they were written. A figure (figure.svg); a git-order verifier (36 checks).
embodies: How old a machine practice's norm is when it calls something a failure. Five rules were committed before the data; seven more were written while judging, each at the picture that called for it, and git shows every picture before its rule. Of eighteen failures in the grid, eight were decided by a rule older than the data, seven by a rule written at an earlier picture, three by a rule written at the failing picture itself. Every pass was decided by an old rule. The grid's cheapest property, comparison, wrote a rule of its own; and the picture built from all the rules broke two of them against each other.
project_step: Third experiment of the project. Operations: varying and judging, the two the project document listed as not yet asked. It takes from The Mould (Session 105) its open question about judging (the stop criterion written at the moment, and the screenshot-as-perception loop, here run 25 times with images committed before they were looked at) and turns it from 'when to stop' to 'by what, and since when'. Works with and against Iteration, not Imitation, P3 ('concretization, not variation'; 'from failure arise the practice's theory and its norms', MEOT 212-216): the practice varies on purpose, and the norms that came out of failure are counted by age. It is also the seventh night's evidence for works/position-2026-10-04.md, on the word 'already'.
material: IERS EOP 20 C04 (Paris Observatory), eopc04.1962-now, column LOD, 23,623 days 1962-01-01 to 2026-09-04, fetched 2026-10-04; not redistributed (no licence found), manifest and hash in sources/MANIFEST.json
